A minor member of the extensive Truesilver family and a veteran of the war, Edgar is a captain in the Purple Dragons stationed in Thunderstone. He is often at odds with his commander Laheralson, as he chafes at the inaction of his commander (who largely sat out the war on garrison duty). Edgar often uses his detachment of Purple Dragons to ride to the defence of the farms along Hullack Forest or in aid of his friend Sir Gilbert Hawklin - actions that make him popular locally. His strong links with the nobility protect him from the discipline of Laheralson, but in turn Laheralson has long been a Crown favorite, so the two live uneasily with each other's influence. 

Edgar has a deep love of the realm, the crown, and its laws - and has a body covered in scars to show for his defense of it.
